description: Grants the loopback dashboard origin (window main only) the core IPC defaults and the two app commands it calls: request_notification_permission (wizard) and open_signin_window (in-app login). The notification plugin's own commands are deliberately NOT granted here: the page never calls them, notify.rs posts every banner from Rust (where plugin permissions do not apply), and granting notification:default to a remote origin would let any script on port 8647 post a detailed banner behind the generic-while-locked rule. The sign-in window is in no capability, so the sign-in page can call nothing.
